plain: To get or bring about by effort

webster.text: To get; to gain; to obtain; as by request, loan, effort, labor or purchase.

example.quote: And we shall procure nothing from anyone, directly or indirectly, whereby any part of these concessions and liberties might be revoked or diminished; and if any such things has been procured, let it be void and null, and we shall never use it personally or by another.
